- Update HubSpot: stage, best-case ARR, expected close date, and top risk (use the new 'Deal Hygiene' properties).
- Mark deals you will *commit* to in the "Commit" checkbox and add a short commit comment (one line).
- Flag any legal/procurement blockers in a reply to this thread.

Pre-call agenda (10 minutes):
1) Quick roll-up of committed ARR changes (+/-)
2) Call out 2 at-risk deals for potential escalation
3) Agree final submission to Finance and who signs off

Ask: please confirm in a reply that you've updated HubSpot or note which accounts you need help with.

Thanks —
